- 驻留是生命周期，自主是权限；自主行动一律为平台注入的自主回合
- 计费面挂在 sub2api：每个已部署 Agent 服务一把 key，部署者预充值、欠费即停
- 萬星对外面是平台门面：调用键即 API key，钱在边界结算
- Registry is a facet component, not an external dependency
- LLM 并发域保持平台共享：按预算治理，按租户拆分推迟到套餐层
- 生产 runner 随平台镜像发布，代码只经镜像通道落地
- 通用客户端登录走设备配对，不走 OIDC
- 结算 v2：部署者分成走收益账，租金留在容量闸门后
- 詞元是 sub2api 的增量谱系 fork：月度跟上游 + 只增不改，与 registry 冻谱系成对

- slim-trace-request-headers — tasks
- Requirement: Deployment propagates by polling within five minutes
- Requirement: Deployments are assigned to a fleet runner
- Requirement: Example prompts ride the AgentCard
- Requirement: Pause and resume are first-class lifecycle actions
- Requirement: Per-agent ports avoid collisions within a runner's span
- Requirement: The access mode governs the deploy identity gate
- Requirement: Upgrade swaps in place with drain
- Requirement: 服务契约可声明会话工具面
- Requirement: 部署按部署者租户化
- Requirement: 检查器抽屉承载节点与边的详情与操作
- Requirement: 自由文本槽位单行呈现与时间线岗位过滤
- Requirement: 节点内嵌迷你 span
- Requirement: 运行时数据流动粒子层
- Requirement: 驾驶舱呈现舰队编排声明
- Requirement: 驾驶舱读面失败自愈与时间线默认选中
- Requirement: 回合触发前的运行时就绪等待
- Requirement: 对外岗位的对话车道注入本队上下文
- Requirement: 岗位可声明上下文使用上限并如实判定
- Requirement: A turn that produces no assistant output settles as a failed turn
- Requirement: One dedicated runtime child per deployed role
- Requirement: A runner hosts only the entries assigned to it
- Requirement: Cell task telemetry reaches the fleet plane read-only
- Requirement: Gateway-spawned cells advertise auth paths that exist in the deployment
- Requirement: Only an explicit stop cancels a turn; session navigation never does
- Requirement: Queued prompt renders as a pending bubble with cancel and preempt actions
- Requirement: Retry progress is visible in the session stream
- Requirement: Socket loss leaves the in-flight turn in a transient reconnect state, not a local finalize
- Requirement: The streaming guard is set synchronously at prompt dispatch
- Requirement: presence 与需求清单上行
- Requirement: 词元的非 chat 模型能力含嵌入且与 chat 入口同源
- Requirements
- Requirement: 卸载包后其绑定行转为历史
- Requirement: 存量单账号平滑迁移
- Requirement: 绑定授权可撤销且失效可见
- Requirement: Paste-time validation rejects malformed or dead PATs
- Requirement: Revoked PAT is surfaced and the server is dropped
- Requirement: In-app render self-test
- Requirement: Server descriptor registry
- Requirement: UI attach with embedded fallback
- Requirement: Window is revealed only after it paints
- Requirement: 崩溃与启动失败必须持久可查
- Requirement: Installed / Market tabs preserved
- Requirement: User can add a new MCP server
- Requirement: User can edit an MCP server configuration
- Requirement: Curated pinned sources declare their entries and pin a commit
- Requirement: External package fetch is per-source and fail-closed
- Requirement: Source adapters are registry-driven and env-gated
- Requirement: One identity provider, three arrival channels
- Requirement: Site marks are text characters sized by placement
- Requirement: The facet CLI carries an honest update path
- Requirement: The facet service deploys independently
- Requirement: 常驻恢复后的簇收敛
- Requirement: The chat viewport is fixed to the browser viewport
- Requirement: Authenticated users can save a personal model binding
- Requirement: WebSocket state is identity-aware without exposing other users
- Requirement: Client can switch the thinking level
- Requirement: Model and thinking level are selected together in the UI
- Requirement: Server lists available models to the client
- Requirement: Server selects a default model at startup
